verdict.rationale: Baseten ships official CLIs: Truss (`uvx truss push`) from the basetenlabs GitHub org builds and deploys models, the docs describe `baseten model push` and one-command checkpoint deployment, and a Baseten Switch CLI reference routes coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI to Model APIs. The agent-setup skill further positions this tooling for agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference beyond a few commands, evidence of agent-friendly features (non-interactive or machine-readable output), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
